status: Instruction counts on a loaded laptop, one thread pinned to cpu 2, a P-core. Times in the lines are not measurements. The change was not kept, and PERFORMANCE-EXPERIMENTS.md records it.

sides.tip: 378127e2, whose code is that of f937fb8d
sides.c2: f937fb8d with c2.patch.txt: HornIx::THING marks the told closure of owl:Thing in horn::absorb, and horn_rules::forall passes over R4, its propagation and its sends, for a filler so marked in a run without the disjunctive rules
sides.c2d: c2 with a counter (c2d.patch.txt). SPARKLES_C2_DIAG=1 prints, at each power of two of forall calls, the calls, those on a role with an inverse, those whose filler is marked, the sends then avoided and whether the index has the disjunctive rules

manifest.build: build.sh.txt: ~/.local/bin/sparkles-heavy-run 8 mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify; bin-NAME.head.txt gives the HEAD and the SHA-256 of the diff

settings.commands: insn.sh BIN TAG FILE [args] with CPUS=2: c2h is --dl-attempt-work 1, the Horn rules alone, twice per side, and c2d the default pipeline once. c2diag.txt comes from SPARKLES_C2_DIAG=1 el_classify --threads 1 --taxonomy FILE [--dl-attempt-work 1] INPUT with bin c2d, unpinned, and keeps the last C2DIAG line and the taxonomy hash

results.insn.txt: insn.sh lines NAME BIN TAG insn=USER_INSTRUCTIONS tax=TAXONOMY_HASH and the report's counters, where concl counts the applied messages, duplicates included
results.c2diag.txt: the counters of c2d. The counters are process totals, so the default pipeline's line includes the attempt, where nothing is marked as skipped
